notes: Faster game start for members. System Milady 0.1.0-alpha.10 now installs on clients as well as servers; on a client it only changes how the game loader starts and does nothing else (no gameplay changes, commands or server features). Its launch modes come from config/system_milady/launch.properties: the module layer is built without Java 21's slow pass, and classes no mixin targets skip Mixin. Both run in auto mode: the first start after a mod change runs the normal path and checks the faster one against it, and only a check with no differences lets later starts use the faster path; a difference, or a first faster start that does not finish, keeps the normal path. ModernFix now loads block and item models and entity renderers on demand (dynamic_resources and dynamic_entity_renderers), which shortened the resource reload by about 20 seconds in test starts on a four-core machine, with no visual difference found in a compatibility pass. Nothing to do for players: the launcher installs the update. Report anything that looks or loads wrong.
